endorsements.quote: Given these limitations, for now, AI technologies should be used to augment human capabilities until they have proven to be more stable and can be built upon more robust datasets.

unlisted_practices: CMS should release clear guidance detailing which functions state Medicaid programs are permitted or encouraged to use AI tools for to reduce administrative burden.
CMS should maintain a public database of permitted AI functions that state Medicaid programs can use to signal their desire to purchase or work with AI vendors and to specify technical requirements.
Policymakers should require CMS to update its AI guidance for state Medicaid programs yearly.
Build auditing functions into AI systems to support human review of outputs.
Implement easy ways to roll back or undo AI-driven actions.
Reserve inherently governmental functions involving exercise of sovereign power or discretion from autonomous AI performance.

screen.reason: Commentary on policy frameworks, governance, and safeguards for using AI in administrative tasks in Medicaid.
